# League Night: Bowling Alley Props

Free CC0 bowling-alley kit by The SideQuest Shop. Base pack only (House Lanes palette). The paid colourways zip was not downloaded.

- itch.io: https://thesidequestshop.itch.io/league-night-bowling-alley-props
- File: `league-night-bowling-alley-props-free.zip` (Version 3)
- Retrieved: 2026-09-04

## Files in this folder

| File | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `pack.glb` | Preferred import. Y-up, metres. Contains all 20 props. |
| `pack.fbx` | Unity/Unreal-oriented export of the same pack. |
| `atlas.png` | Shared 1024×1024 gradient atlas (keep next to the model). |
| `README.md` | Upstream prop list, triangle counts, and pivot notes. |
| `LICENSE.txt` | CC0 1.0 Universal (copied from the zip). |

Prop inventory (from upstream README): lane section, approach, bumpers, single pin, 10-pin formation, pinsetter, ball rack, house balls, ball return, score console, monitor rig, bench row, single seat, shoe counter, cubby wall, shoe pair, trophy case, pennant board, BOWL sign, arrow sign. 34,280 tris total.
